description: Compact 'vs last month' delta pill used in the Insights Month Summary headline (on Net, Income, and Expenses). Conveys direction with icon + word + color together so it is never color-only.

percent.description: Change vs last month, e.g. 8.4 or -12.0. Sign indicates raw direction of the underlying metric.

metric.description: Which figure this chip annotates. Drives the good/bad color mapping.

hasPrior.description: False when there is no previous month to compare (first month of data). Renders the 'new' variant instead of a percentage.

showSuffix.description: When true append 'vs last month' / 'vs last mo'. The Net hero chip shows the full suffix; the per-figure chips use the short form.

colorLogic.note: Mirrors existing changeColor(pct, isExpense). Direction is good/bad, not just up/down.

accessibility.label: {word} {percent} percent versus last month | 'new this month' when hasPrior is false
accessibility.note: icon + word + color together; never relies on color alone
